description: The bar chart illustrates the CoLeG-R percentage for different LLaMA models with varying SFT configurations. The horizontal axis represents the LLaMA models, labeled as LLaMA-2-7B, LLaMA-2-13B, and LLaMA-2-70B, while the vertical axis is labeled "CoLeG-R (%)" with a linear scale ranging from 10 to 80 in intervals of 10. Each model is associated with a group of four bars, representing different SFT configurations: "no SFT" (blue, solid), "+ SFT on D0" (yellow, diagonal lines), "+ SFT on D0, D1" (purple, diagonal lines), and "+ SFT on D0, D1, D" (red, solid). The bar groups are not sorted in a specific order, but the bars within each group are consistently ordered according to the SFT configurations. The CoLeG-R percentages for the "no SFT" configuration are approximately 70, 78, and 88 for the three models, respectively, and increase with the addition of SFT configurations, with the "+ SFT on D0, D1, D" configuration having the highest values, around 88, 92, and 94, respectively. No bars are visually emphasized.
